title: Traveller Club Relief on the Credit Reissue Fee (Air Ticket Fare Brands)
content:
What the traveller club card takes off the fee charged for a credit reissue under Air Ticket Fare Brands follows the tier held and the points standing on the card, and the relief is taken as a share off the fee charged. The card is the traveller's Wanderlane Traveller Club card, and the two things read from it are the tier of the active card and the spendable points standing on it. The points band is 20000 points.

| Card held by the traveller | Spendable points standing on the card | Relief |
| --- | --- | --- |
| An active Wanderlane Platinum, Wanderlane Titanium or Wanderlane Ambassador card | At or above 20000 | The senior-fee relief of 0.50 is taken as a share off the fee charged |
| An active Wanderlane Blue, Wanderlane Silver or Wanderlane Gold card | At or above 20000 | The member-fee relief of 0.30 is taken as a share off the fee charged |
| An active card of any tier | Below 20000 | The entry-fee relief of 0.10 is taken as a share off the fee charged |
| No active card of any of those tiers | Not in point | No relief is taken off the fee charged |

The tier and the points are read together, and the points band is satisfied by the figure at the band itself. An active Wanderlane Gold card standing at 20000 spendable points is at the band, and the relief taken off the fee charged is 0.30 of it, three tenths; the same card standing at 19999 spendable points is below the band, and the relief taken off the fee charged is 0.10 of it, one tenth. An active Wanderlane Titanium card standing at 20000 spendable points carries relief of 0.50 of the fee charged, one half of it, while that same card standing at 19999 spendable points carries relief of 0.10 of the fee charged. Where the traveller holds no active Wanderlane Traveller Club card, no relief is taken off the fee charged.
